mechanism: NSAIDs reduce renal perfusion and inhibit prostaglandin-mediated vasodilation, counteracting the diuretic and natriuretic effects of loop diuretics while increasing risk of acute kidney injury and electrolyte disturbances.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) and electrolytes regularly; consider alternative analgesia or reduce NSAID dose; ensure adequate hydration and blood pressure monitoring.
